Definition: the back (as rounded); by analogy, the top or rim, a boss, a vault, arch of eye, bulwarks, etc.
BiblicalUsage: 1) convex surface, back; 1a) back (of man); 1b) mound (for illicit worship); 1c) boss (convex projection of shield); 1d) bulwarks, breastworks (of arguments-fig.); 1e) brow, eyebrow; 1f) rim (of wheel)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
